title: Pipeline: Lifestyle, agent-written prompt
prompt: Written by the agent for each run, exactly as the real pipeline does.
look_for: The real pipeline's output. Would you publish this as it is?

title: Pipeline: In-use, agent-written prompt
prompt: Written by the agent for each run, exactly as the real pipeline does.
look_for: The real pipeline's output. Does the texture suggest use without crowding the product?

title: Sunlit window ledge
prompt: Photorealistic commercial photograph of a pale travertine bathroom ledge in warm morning window light from the left. The stone is one continuous open surface in sharp focus. Behind and to the right, out of focus, an aloe plant in a terracotta pot and folded white towels. 50mm lens at eye level, shallow depth of field, soft shadows falling right. No bottles, packaging, labels, text, logos or people.
look_for: Baseline brand scene: natural stone texture, believable window light, open space on the ledge.

title: Lather on stone
prompt: Photorealistic close-up commercial photograph of a small, delicate swirl of pearly white lather resting on pale pitted travertine, with fine micro-bubbles and a few water droplets. Most of the stone is open and clean. Soft side light from a window on the left, 85mm macro lens, shallow depth of field, warm neutral palette. No bottles, packaging, labels, text, logos or people.
look_for: Foam realism: fine bubbles, not plastic or whipped cream. The foam shouldn't dominate.

title: Limestone spa niche
prompt: Photorealistic commercial photograph of a recessed pale limestone niche in a spa bathroom, with a single sprig of fresh eucalyptus lying at the right of the shelf. Soft overcast daylight from the left, gentle tonal falloff, calm and quiet. 50mm lens, straight-on, shallow depth of field. No bottles, packaging, labels, text, logos or people.
look_for: Geometry of the niche, scale of the shelf, and a calm, uncluttered feel.

title: Linen vanity
prompt: Photorealistic commercial photograph of a pale oak vanity top with a softly creased natural linen cloth at the back and a small unglazed ceramic dish to the right. Diffused daylight from a sheer curtain, warm neutral palette, a clear open area of wood in the foreground. 50mm lens, slightly above eye level. No bottles, packaging, labels, text, logos or people.
look_for: Fabric and wood detail, and a setting that's different from stone but still on brand.

title: Dappled garden light
prompt: Photorealistic commercial photograph of a rough sandstone garden ledge in dappled afternoon sunlight filtering through leaves, with crisp leaf shadows moving across the stone. Soft green foliage far behind in heavy bokeh. Open stone in the foreground. 50mm lens at low angle. No bottles, packaging, labels, text, logos or people.
look_for: Hard light is difficult: do the shadows look real, and would a composited product still fit?

title: Steamy shower niche
prompt: Photorealistic commercial photograph of a wet sage-grey tile shower niche with water beading on the tiles and soft steam in the air. Diffuse overhead light through the steam, moody but bright, with an open, wet stone shelf in the foreground. 35mm lens. No bottles, packaging, labels, text, logos or people.
look_for: Water and steam realism, and whether the contrast stays calm enough for the brand.

title: Warm evening bath
prompt: Photorealistic commercial photograph of a stone bath edge in the evening, lit by warm low lamplight with one unlit candle far behind, deep soft shadows and a clear open stretch of stone in the foreground. 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, cosy and quiet. No bottles, packaging, labels, text, logos or people.
look_for: Low light is off the usual brand look. Does it hold together, or get muddy and noisy?

title: Studio plinth
prompt: Photorealistic studio photograph of a simple round plaster plinth on a seamless muted sage background with a soft gradient. Large soft key light from the upper left, a gentle shadow, no other objects. Clean, minimal, premium. 85mm lens at plinth height. No bottles, packaging, labels, text, logos or people.
look_for: Simple scenes reveal banding, fake gradients and plastic surfaces.

title: Wide website hero
prompt: Photorealistic wide commercial photograph for a website hero: a long pale travertine countertop running across the frame, with soft morning light from the left. The left two thirds are calm and open, with a softly blurred tiled wall behind. At the far right, small and out of focus, an aloe plant in a terracotta pot. 35mm lens, shallow depth of field. No bottles, packaging, labels, text, logos or people.
look_for: Wide framing: does it hold up at this shape, and leave calm space for a headline and product?

title: Stress: mirror and shelves
prompt: Photorealistic commercial photograph of a modern bathroom vanity with a large mirror above it, open shelves on the wall and a white ceramic basin, in bright natural light. The stone counter in the foreground is clear and open. 35mm lens at eye level. Absolutely nothing on the shelves. No bottles, packaging, labels, text, logos or people.
look_for: This scene tempts models to add products. Look for invented bottles, text, logos and impossible reflections.

title: Locked camera, shifting light
prompt: Locked-off camera with no camera movement. Soft morning light shifts slowly across the scene. The product stays perfectly still with its label sharp and unchanged.
look_for: The safest shot for a listing. Is the camera really still, and does the label hold?

title: Slow push-in
prompt: A very slow, steady push-in toward the product. The product stays centred, whole and in frame throughout, and its label stays sharp and unchanged. Soft light, no shake.
look_for: The earlier video drifted the bottle out of frame. Does it stay centred?

title: Gentle arc
prompt: The camera moves in a slow, slight arc to the right around the product, revealing gentle parallax in the background. The product itself doesn't change shape, and its front label stays facing the camera and legible.
look_for: Parallax is hard. Does the bottle's shape and label survive the change in angle?

title: Rack focus
prompt: Locked-off camera. The focus shifts slowly from the blurred background to the product, which ends in crisp focus with its label sharp and legible.
look_for: A premium-feeling move. Does the focus change look optical, and does the label resolve?

title: Drifting steam
prompt: Locked-off camera. Thin wisps of steam drift slowly across the background behind the product. The product stays perfectly still and its label stays sharp.
look_for: Atmosphere without touching the product. Is the steam natural, and does it stay behind?

title: Leaves in a breeze
prompt: Locked-off camera. The leaves stir very slightly in a soft breeze and sunlight moves gently across the wall. The product stays perfectly still with its label sharp.
look_for: Do small natural movements look real, while everything else holds still?

title: Stress: water droplets on the bottle
prompt: Locked-off camera. A few small water droplets slowly run down the outside of the bottle. The bottle's shape, colour and label text don't change at all.
look_for: Motion on the product. Does the label text survive, or does it smear?

title: Stress: a hand lifts the bottle
prompt: A hand enters from the right and gently lifts the bottle from the surface, then the shot ends. The bottle keeps its exact shape, cap and label as it moves.
look_for: The hardest test of product identity. Expect failures, and note which model fails least badly.
